Question: When i do zikr of allah lots of sneezing come to me. pls tell me why it happens in the light of quran and hadith. Answer ID: 6876 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 812/812=M/1429) May be it is an effect of the brain weakness and the zikr is causing some pressure. You should consult any physician.
